label: Mountains
blurb: The peak-bagging lists people actually finish: the New Hampshire 48, the Adirondack 46, the Catskills, every state's high point.

fields.id: stable slug, name + state (never changes once sent)
fields.title: the name the list's own club uses; other names go in aka
fields.state: two-letter state code of the summit (identity)
fields.elevation: summit elevation in feet, as the list's club publishes it (description, not identity)
fields.aka: other names a task might use
